name: Entra Account Lifecycle Abuse
description: Entra ID (Azure AD) accounts can be created, disabled, reset, and deleted. Attackers often create a user, use it, then delete it within hours so it never shows up in a weekly review. They also try passwords against disabled accounts, reset passwords they should not control, or sign into other companies' tenants with a compromised identity. The story is always the same: get a mailbox or a role, do the damage, erase the account. Creations followed quickly by deletions, and sign-ins to disabled users, are the practical tells.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
